beetle.definition: A small car, the Volkswagen Beetle (original version made 1938–2003, similar models made 1997–2010 and since 2011)

family.definition: A group of people who are closely related to one another (by blood, marriage or adoption); kin; for example, a set of parents and their children; an immediate family.

genus.definition: A rank in the classification of organisms, below family and above species; a taxon at that rank.

the.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.

ground.definition: The surface of the Earth, as opposed to the sky or water or underground.

found.definition: To encounter or discover by accident; to happen upon.

are.definition: An accepted (but deprecated and rarely used) SI unit of area equal to 100 square metres, or a former unit of approximately the same extent. Symbol: a.

designed.definition: To plan and carry out (a picture, work of art, construction etc.).

and.definition: In rhythm, the second half of a divided beat.

since.definition: From a specified time in the past.

post.definition: A long dowel or plank protruding from the ground; a fencepost; a lightpost.

rest.definition: (of a person or animal) Relief from work or activity by sleeping; sleep.

rounded.definition: To shape something into a curve.

historic.definition: A history, a non-fiction account of the past.

places.definition: (physical) An area; somewhere within an area.

building.definition: The act or process by which something is built; construction.

polished.definition: To shine; to make a surface very smooth or shiny by rubbing, cleaning, or grinding.

listed.definition: To create or recite a list.

been.definition: A flying insect, of the clade Anthophila within the hymenopteran superfamily Apoidea, known for its organised societies (though only a minority have them), for collecting pollen and (in some species) producing wax and honey.

office.definition: A ceremonial duty or service, particularly:

built.definition: To form (something) by combining materials or parts.

topped.definition: To cover on the top or with a top.

massive.definition: A homogeneous mass of rock, not layered and without an obvious crystal structure.

bronze.definition: A naturally occurring or man-made alloy of copper, usually in combination with tin, but also with one or more other metals.

register.definition: A machine that tabulates the amount of sales transactions, makes a permanent and cumulative record of them, and has a drawer in which cash can be kept.

includes.definition: A piece of source code or other content that is dynamically retrieved for inclusion in another item.

lobby.definition: An entryway or reception area; vestibule; passageway; corridor.

arts.definition: The conscious production or arrangement of sounds, colours, forms, movements, or other elements in a manner that affects the senses and emotions, usually specifically the production of the beautiful in a graphic or plastic medium.

dome.definition: A structural element resembling the hollow upper half of a sphere; a cupola

grills.definition: A grating; a grid of wire or a sheet of material with a pattern of holes or slots, usually used to protect something while allowing the passage of air and liquids. Typical uses: to allow air through a fan while preventing fingers or objects from passing; to allow people to talk to somebody, while preventing attack.

saucer.definition: A small shallow dish to hold a cup and catch drips.

style.definition: Senses relating to a thin, pointed object.

community.definition: A group sharing a common understanding, and often the same language, law, manners, and/or tradition.
